Uses: CMP-03 Safety channel processor, CMP-07 Vehicle state sensing

Verified by (WP-S-03): Fault injection of unsafe commands in HIL; scenario tests; formal check of the envelope rules

Uses: CMP-03 Safety channel processor, CMP-07 Vehicle state sensing

Verified by (WP-S-03): Fault injection of steering commands; scenario tests with oncoming traffic and cyclists

Uses: CMP-07 Vehicle state sensing, CMP-06 Drive-by-wire

Verified by (WP-S-03): Fault injection on the vehicle side and on the safety channel; timing measurement

What it does: Holds decelerations above the comfortable level that the safety channel does not confirm to the firm level
Verified by (WP-S-03): Fault injection of spurious braking commands; replay of false-positive scenes

What it does: Checks every command from Autoware and from remote operations for loss, delay, sequence, age, signature (CSR-01) and plausibility
Verified by (WP-S-03): Fault injection of lost, late, repeated, corrupted and unsigned commands; timing measurement

Uses: CMP-06 Drive-by-wire, CMP-07 Vehicle state sensing, CMP-08 Park brake, CMP-09 Door system

Verified by (WP-S-03): Vehicle tests of stop and hold on the geofence's gradients; fault injection of release messages and door states

What it does: Compares the commanded indicator with commanded and achieved steering, and switches to hazard lights on a mismatch
Detects faults of the monitor's own processor, memory, clock and software (lockstep, memory protection, independent watchdog) and stops its output so the vehicle's own stop takes over
Verified by (WP-S-03): Hardware fault injection; diagnostic coverage analysis (WP-H-04)

Verified by (WP-S-03): Detection tests across the ODD; false-positive rate from field and replay data

What it does: Delivers speed, acceleration and steering angle to the monitor on its own path, with the sensors' own fault flags

Reports door state to the monitor and inhibits motion with any door open
Keeps the monitor, the safety channel and the actuation path powered after any single fault of the Autoware computer's supply
